Title: Semantic Search Gap
Content: Current MemorySmith semantic search is local token, tag, title, reference, and alias scoring over file-backed records. Hybrid search now improves retrieval by fusing Lucene.NET lexical rank with that semantic signal through RRF, but it still does not use embeddings or a vector index. A more general tool needs durable vector search, query/result scoring, match reasons, fixture tests with real project memories, and a migration path that does not force PostgreSQL before the product needs it.
